prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Paint the supplied paint_mask_guide.png, keeping its exact silhouette, positions, sizes, openings and orthographic views. This is a production paint + material mask view atlas of Fre's Chain Boots.
Inputs: paint_mask_guide.png is the edit target and sole authority for geometry/layout; design_reference.png is approved material/detail reference; icon_x8.png is original colour reference (magenta is background, never paint magenta).
Output ONE transparent PNG, 3:4 canvas, 1536x2048 if possible. Three columns and FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows 3-4 repeat the exact same five views: FRONT (pair), BACK (pair), LEFT (one side profile) / RIGHT (opposite side profile), TOP (pair), empty. Preserve every guide object exactly. Do not redraw, enlarge, move, redesign or change camera.
Rows 1-2 PAINT ONLY: unlit base colour, tall boots of fine bronze-gold chain mail reaching up the calf, dark-green leather rim with gold band at the top, dark-green leather welt and gold band around the sole. Dark brown leather interior where guide has visible interior surfaces. Follow design reference detail scaled to views; fine chain mail covers shaft and foot. No lighting, cast shadows, ambient occlusion, hot highlights, reflections.
Rows 3-4 MATERIAL MASK ONLY: identical five silhouettes filled with flat pure colours, no shading, texture, outlines or antialiased colour blends inside. Pure red #FF0000 for ALL metal including chainmail and gold bands (solid red areas, no chain-link pattern). Pure green #00FF00 for all leather including green rim, welt, sole and brown inner leather. Pure blue #0000FF only for cloth/lining if cloth; pure yellow #FFFF00 only matte nonmetal solids. Every silhouette pixel gets exactly one material colour, no pixels outside silhouettes.
All background and existing gaps/openings remain fully transparent. Visible inner boot surfaces are surfaces, preserve their shape. Column 3 rows 2 and 4 stay completely empty transparent. No text, outlines, ground, glow, sparkles, aura, grid, labels. Paint only existing grey objects.
